title: Policy Recommendation
description: A constrained, analyst-reviewable policy recommendation emitted by the security agent. See docs/modular-implementation-plan.md section 3.3. action_type is intentionally a CLOSED enumeration: integration rule 5 forbids a generative model from emitting arbitrary executable policy or shell commands, and only predefined, analyst-approved actions may reach the infrastructure adapter (rule 6). Adding a new action_type requires a reviewed contract change, not a model output.

action_type.description: Closed set of enforcement actions the infrastructure adapter knows how to apply. deny_destination is the only value the MVP needs.

target.description: Object the action applies to, e.g. a destination host.

scope.description: Actor/agent the action is scoped to.
